'''Efridge Engelhardt I have bring him now''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Efridge Engelhardt]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-17997">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17997 I have bring him now], DeckTech (Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt, 1 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17997/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17997/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Efridge Engelhardt]]

== Original post ==

'''I have bring him now'''
* '''Author:''' Efridge "Efridge" Engelhardt
* '''Published:''' August 1, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Good ol' fashion beat down.

=== Strategy ===

Drop Emperor and gang to occupy a docking bay and start getting lotsa force. When you drop Vader they will probably drop luke as far away as possible. Drop maul to luke's site with the assistance of BDC, hack him, i have you now, and your gonna be winning by like 20. good against WYS (maul) and just drops 7's back in and tracks em. its fun to play and solid. thanks =)
